name: Dropzone
description: An upload surface: outline, upload icon, localized status line, optional hint and a browse button. Presentational — it takes a state, it does not listen to a drag stream.

fields.borderColor: StateValue<ThemedColor>? - per-state; the DropzoneState token wins
fields.minHeight: double? - null = 0 (the surface hugs its content)
fields.statusStyle: TextStyle? - merged onto the default; null = 14
fields.hintStyle: TextStyle? - merged onto the default; null = 12
fields.dragBorder: ThemedColor? - border while a drag hovers; null = the DropzoneState.dragging token (primary)

notes: `FileDropzone` is now `Dropzone`: the old name implied it owned a file list, which it never did (that is `primitives/file_value/`).
`hotDropEnabled` / `hotDropping` are replaced by `DropzoneState` plus `isDragOver`; the old pair could disagree with each other and with `state`, and `_resolveBorderColor` had to reconcile all three.
Status strings and the browse label are `ShadcnLocalizations` getters (seven new getters, English fallback only, no invented translations).
The border is a plain 1px outline, not a dashed one: the kit has no dashed primitive, so the shape is honest rather than approximated with a repeating image.
